prose: Basis: the author's Show HN post text from the feed. '3 & Done' is a personal task system built by an east-coast software engineer to handle life's drudgery. It accepts voice input for rapid capture - storing the audio locally - as well as text, positioning itself as the single trusted place for everything you need to do. The pitch is deliberate simplicity: capture fast, focus on the tasks that matter.
